faq_heading: Questions B2B teams ask about LinkedIn automation and agencies

faqs.q: Is LinkedIn automation better than a LinkedIn agency?
faqs.a: Neither is better for everyone. A tool suits teams with time to run it themselves. An agency suits teams that want people to do the work. A managed AI agent sits in between: the work is done for you, but every message is still personal and every step is tracked.

faqs.q: Can LinkedIn automation get my account restricted?
faqs.a: Yes, if it is used carelessly. LinkedIn's User Agreement does not allow bots or unapproved automated methods to send messages or scrape data. Sending at human pace, keeping messages personal and keeping a person in the loop lowers that risk.

faqs.q: How fast can I see results from LinkedIn outreach?
faqs.a: Clara AI aims to show you a first demo within 7 days. Accepted invites usually start coming in during the first weeks, and real conversations follow as the agent keeps following up.

faqs.q: Who writes the messages in a managed AI agent setup?
faqs.a: The AI agent drafts personal messages from each prospect's profile and your offer, using rules you agree with us. A person from Clara AI checks the setup, and you approve the tone before anything goes out.

faqs.q: Who is a managed LinkedIn outreach agent not right for?
faqs.a: It is not right for consumer brands that want likes, for one-off social media posting, or for teams that have no budget for a paid monthly service. It is built for B2B firms selling to other businesses.
